recipes.name: Chilled gazpacho
recipes.method_note: Ripe tomatoes make or break it. Taste and add vinegar if it is flat.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:tomato-medium}}, half of {{ing:cucumber}} and {{ing:pepper-bell}} roughly.
Put in a blender with {{ing:garlic-clove}} and torn {{ing:sourdough}}.
Add {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} and {{ing:salt}}.
Blend until smooth.
Chill at least 2 hours, until very cold.
Dice the rest of the cucumber. Scatter over to serve.
Cut {{ing:watermelon}} into bite-size chunks. Pile on a plate.
Crumble over {{ing:feta}}.
Slice {{ing:red-onion}} very thinly. Scatter over.
Tear over {{ing:fresh-mint}}.
Squeeze over {{ing:lime}}. Drizzle with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Slice {{ing:peach}} into wedges. Lay on a plate.
Tear {{ing:burrata}} open. Put in the middle.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-basil}}.
Drizzle with {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}}.
Grind over {{ing:black-pepper-ground}}.

recipes.name: Courgette fritters with tzatziki
recipes.method_note: Squeezing the courgette is what stops them going soggy.

steps.instruction: Grate {{ing:courgette}}. Toss with {{ing:salt}} in a sieve. Leave 10 minutes.
Squeeze out as much water as you can.
Mix with {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:flour-plain}}, crumbled {{ing:feta}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-mint}}.
Put a frying pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Fry spoonfuls 3 minutes each side, until golden.
Serve with {{ing:tzatziki}}.
Put a frying pan on a high heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Slice {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:chilli-fresh}}. Fry 30 seconds.
Add {{ing:king-prawns-raw}}. Fry 3 minutes, turning, until pink all through.
Squeeze over the juice of one {{ing:lime}}.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}. Serve with the other lime in wedges.
Slice {{ing:cucumber}} as thinly as you can.
Stir {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}} until dissolved. Toss with the cucumber.
Leave 15 minutes. Drain.
Lay {{ing:smoked-salmon}} on plates. Pile the cucumber beside it.
Spoon on {{ing:creme-fraiche}}. Scatter with {{ing:fresh-dill}}. Add a wedge of {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Melon and prosciutto
recipes.method_note: Any ripe melon works. Cantaloupe is the classic.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:watermelon}} into long wedges. Cut off the rind.
Drape {{ing:prosciutto}} over the melon.
Tear over {{ing:fresh-mint}}.
Drizzle with {{ing:olive-oil}}. Grind over {{ing:black-pepper-ground}}.
Quarter {{ing:cherry-tomato}}. Put in a bowl.
Tear in {{ing:fresh-basil}}. Add {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:salt}}. Leave 10 minutes.
Toast {{ing:sourdough}}.
Rub each slice with {{ing:garlic-clove}} cut in half.
Spoon the tomatoes and their juices on top.
Cut {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} into chunks.
Toss with the juice of {{ing:lemon}}, {{ing:dried-oregano}}, grated {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}. Leave 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill on a high heat 12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Warm {{ing:pitta-bread}}.
Fill with the chicken, sliced {{ing:tomato-medium}}, {{ing:red-onion}} and {{ing:tzatziki}}.

recipes.name: Steak with chimichurri
recipes.method_note: Rest the steak on a warm plate. The juices settle back in.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:fresh-parsley}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} finely.
Mix with {{ing:dried-oregano}}, {{ing:chilli-flakes}}, {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} and 5 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Rub {{ing:beef-sirloin}} with the rest of the oil and {{ing:salt}}.
Put a griddle pan on a high heat until smoking.
Cook the steaks 3 minutes each side for medium-rare.
Rest 5 minutes. Slice. Spoon over the chimichurri.
Chop {{ing:fresh-parsley}}, {{ing:fresh-mint}}, {{ing:capers}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} finely together.
Stir in {{ing:mustard-dijon}}, the juice of {{ing:lemon}} and 5 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Rub {{ing:lamb-chops}} with the rest of the oil.
Put a griddle pan on a high heat.
Cook the chops 3 minutes each side, until browned but pink inside.
Rest 3 minutes. Spoon over the salsa verde.

recipes.name: Sea bass with tomatoes and olives

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Halve {{ing:cherry-tomato}}. Toss in a dish with {{ing:olives-pitted}}, sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} and 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Roast 15 minutes, until the tomatoes are soft.
Lay {{ing:sea-bass-fillet}} on top, skin side up. Brush with the rest of the oil.
Roast 8 minutes, until the fish flakes.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-basil}}. Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}.
Boil {{ing:new-potatoes}} 15 minutes. Add {{ing:green-beans}} for the last 4 minutes. Drain.
Boil {{ing:egg-medium}} 7 minutes. Cool in cold water. Peel and halve.
Rub {{ing:tuna-steak}} with 1 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}. Sear 2 minutes each side in a hot pan.
Whisk the rest of the oil with {{ing:mustard-dijon}} and {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}.
Arrange {{ing:cos-lettuce}}, the potatoes, beans, {{ing:cherry-tomato}} and {{ing:olives-pitted}} on plates.
Top with sliced tuna and the eggs. Spoon over the dressing.

recipes.name: Mussels in white wine and garlic
recipes.method_note: Ready-cooked mussels in their shells only need heating through.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan with a lid on a medium heat. Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}}.
Chop {{ing:shallot}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Fry 4 minutes, until soft.
Add {{ing:wine-white}}. Bubble 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:mussels-cooked}}. Cover. Cook 4 minutes, shaking, until hot through.
Stir in {{ing:double-cream}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Serve in bowls with {{ing:sourdough}} for the juices.
Cook {{ing:penne-dry}} in boiling salted water for the time on the packet. Keep a mug of water.
Put a large frying pan on a medium-high heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Grate {{ing:courgette}} coarsely. Fry with sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} 6 minutes, until soft.
Add the drained pasta and the zest and juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Stir in {{ing:ricotta}} and a splash of pasta water until creamy.
Top with torn {{ing:fresh-basil}} and grated {{ing:parmesan}}.

swaps.text: A vegetarian hard cheese: most parmesan is made with animal rennet

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:halloumi}} and {{ing:peach}}. Brush with 1 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Put a griddle pan on a high heat.
Griddle the halloumi 2 minutes each side, until striped.
Griddle the peaches 1 minute each side.
Toss {{ing:rocket}} and sliced {{ing:cucumber}} on plates. Add the halloumi and peaches.
Whisk the rest of the oil with {{ing:honey}} and the juice of {{ing:lemon}}. Spoon over. Add {{ing:fresh-mint}}.
Heat the oven to 200C. Unroll {{ing:puff-pastry}} onto a lined tray.
Spread {{ing:pesto}} over, leaving a 3 cm edge.
Slice {{ing:tomato-medium}} and {{ing:mozzarella}}. Layer over the pesto.
Fold the edges in over the filling.
Brush the pastry with beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Bake 30 minutes, until golden. Scatter with {{ing:fresh-basil}}.

swaps.text: Most pesto has parmesan in it; look for a vegetarian one if that matters

recipes.name: Ratatouille
recipes.method_note: Better the next day, and good cold.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry 8 minutes, until soft.
Cut {{ing:aubergine}}, {{ing:courgette}} and {{ing:pepper-bell}} into chunks. Add to the pan.
Fry 10 minutes, stirring, until starting to soften.
Add sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}. Simmer 30 minutes, until soft and rich.
Stir in torn {{ing:fresh-basil}}. Serve with {{ing:sourdough}}.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut {{ing:pepper-bell}} and {{ing:red-onion}} into chunks. Toss in a tin with 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Drain {{ing:chickpeas-tinned}}. Add to the tin. Roast 25 minutes.
Pour hot {{ing:stock-vegetable}} over {{ing:couscous-dry}}. Cover 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
Stir in the vegetables, the rest of the oil and the juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Scatter with chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}} and {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}.
Cook {{ing:rice-jasmine-dry}} for the time on the packet.
Cut {{ing:tofu-firm}} into cubes. Toss with {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:sesame-oil}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Fry the tofu in a hot pan 6 minutes, until browned. Add the marinade at the end.
Boil {{ing:edamame-frozen}} 3 minutes. Drain.
Slice {{ing:cucumber}}, {{ing:mango}} and {{ing:spring-onion}}.
Fill bowls with rice, tofu and the vegetables. Sprinkle with {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.
Slice {{ing:tomato-medium}}. Lay on a plate.
Slice {{ing:red-onion}} thinly. Scatter over.
Sprinkle with {{ing:salt}}. Tear over {{ing:fresh-basil}}.
Drizzle with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Boil {{ing:new-potatoes}} 15 minutes, until tender. Drain. Halve.
Whisk {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:wholegrain-mustard}} and {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}.
Toss the warm potatoes in the dressing.
steps.note: Warm potatoes soak up more flavour.

steps.instruction: Stir in sliced {{ing:spring-onion}} and snipped {{ing:chives}}.
Boil {{ing:green-beans}} 4 minutes. Cool under cold water.
Chop {{ing:shallot}} finely.
Whisk {{ing:mustard-dijon}}, {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Toss the beans and shallot in the dressing.
Halve {{ing:cucumber}} lengthways. Scoop out the seeds. Slice.
Stir into {{ing:greek-yoghurt}}.
Add chopped {{ing:fresh-dill}}, the juice of half of {{ing:lemon}} and {{ing:salt}}.
Pour hot {{ing:stock-vegetable}} over {{ing:couscous-dry}}. Cover 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork.
Stir in {{ing:olive-oil}} and the zest and juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Add chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

recipes.name: Eton mess
recipes.method_note: Fold at the last minute, or the meringue softens.

steps.instruction: Hull and quarter {{ing:strawberries}}. Toss with {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Leave 10 minutes.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} to soft peaks.
Break {{ing:meringue-nests}} into chunks.
Fold the strawberries and meringue through the cream. Serve at once.

recipes.name: Summer pudding
recipes.method_note: The weight presses the juice into the bread so it turns out deep red.

steps.instruction: Put the berries and {{ing:sugar-caster}} in a pan. Warm 3 minutes, until the juices run.
Cut the crusts off 8 slices of {{ing:bread-white-sliced-loaf}}.
Dip the bread in the juice. Line a 1 litre bowl, overlapping.
Spoon in {{ing:raspberries}}, {{ing:blueberries}} and {{ing:strawberries}} from the pan.
Cover with more soaked bread. Put a plate and a weight on top.
Chill overnight. Turn out onto a plate.
Heat the oven to 180C. Line two 20 cm tins.
Beat {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} until pale and fluffy.
Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}} one at a time.
Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}}. Divide between the tins.
Bake 22 minutes, until springy. Cool.
Spread one cake with {{ing:jam-strawberry}}, whipped {{ing:double-cream}} and sliced {{ing:strawberries}}. Top with the other.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Halve {{ing:peach}}. Take out the stones. Lay cut side up in a dish.
Drizzle with 2 tbsp of {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Roast 15 minutes, until soft and syrupy.
Stir the rest of the honey into {{ing:greek-yoghurt}}.
Serve the peaches warm with the yoghurt. Scatter with chopped {{ing:pistachios}}.
Cut the rind off {{ing:watermelon}}. Blend the flesh until smooth.
Stir in {{ing:sugar-caster}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}} until dissolved.
Pour into a shallow box. Freeze 1 hour.
Scrape with a fork. Freeze 3 hours more, scraping every hour, until icy flakes.

recipes.name: No-churn raspberry ripple ice cream
recipes.method_note: No machine and no stirring: the condensed milk keeps it soft.

steps.instruction: Mash {{ing:raspberries}} with {{ing:icing-sugar}}.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}}, {{ing:condensed-milk}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}} to soft peaks.
Spoon half into a freezer box. Dot with half the raspberries.
Add the rest of the cream and raspberries. Swirl with a knife.
Freeze 6 hours, until firm.

recipes.name: Mango and passion fruit with lime

steps.instruction: Peel {{ing:mango}}. Slice the flesh off the stone.
Lay on a plate.
Halve {{ing:passion-fruit}}. Scoop the seeds over.
Squeeze over {{ing:lime}}. Add {{ing:fresh-mint}} leaves.
Heat the oven to 190C. Butter a baking dish with {{ing:butter-unsalted}}.
Stone {{ing:cherries}}. Spread in the dish.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} until frothy.
Whisk in {{ing:flour-plain}}, then {{ing:milk-whole}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Pour over the cherries. Bake 35 minutes, until puffed and barely set in the middle.
Dust with {{ing:icing-sugar}}. Serve warm.
Zest one {{ing:lemon}}. Squeeze the juice of all four.
Heat {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:water}} and the zest until the sugar dissolves. Cool.
Stir in the lemon juice. Strain.
Top up with {{ing:sparkling-water}} and ice.
Blend {{ing:watermelon}} until smooth. Sieve.
Add the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Pour over ice with {{ing:fresh-mint}} leaves.
Top up with {{ing:sparkling-water}}.
Slice {{ing:strawberries}}. Put in 4 glasses with ice.
Pour in {{ing:wine-rose}}.
Top up with {{ing:sparkling-water}}.

steps.instruction: Pour {{ing:wine-red}} and {{ing:orange-juice}} into a jug.
Slice {{ing:orange}} and {{ing:apple-medium}}. Add with {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Chill 2 hours.
Add ice and {{ing:lemonade}} to serve.
